# LLM-candidate matching and minting pipeline

Processes LLM-derived candidate facts by attempting to match them to existing entities via external_key, anchor overlap, and name similarity (in that order), absorbing matches or minting new entities when no match is found. Deterministic tie-breakers and slug generation ensure stable, reproducible outcomes across runs.
